summary: Python terminal wrapper for legacy exact-cover plan; required CLI inputs: repository root, plan directory, output path; loads implementation contract and command registry; executes terminal_validation.py from repository root and hashes stdout; derives validated command IDs from slice red/green lists; fails on validation error or command-registry drift; emits schema quick-dev-implementation-complete.v1 with plan ID, predicate, status, failures, contract/registry hashes, terminal command ID, validated IDs, authorization, lifecycle_transition none, stdout hash; on pass publishes deterministic receipt under repair/round-1, using contract-hash suffix on conflicting canonical receipt and erroring on successor conflict; writes output JSON and exits 0 on pass, 1 on failure.
